# Lint — clean KB with a well-formed page

exec akb init clean-kb
cd clean-kb

stdin ../good-note.md
exec akb write good-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/good-note.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/good-note.md 'A well-formed note'

# Lint exits 0 (orphans are warning-severity), but must NOT have
# broken_links, missing_frontmatter, or type_orphan
exec akb lint
! stdout 'broken_links'
! stdout 'missing_frontmatter'
! stdout 'type_orphan'

-- good-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Good Note
summary: A well-formed note for testing
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
This is a well-formed note with proper frontmatter.
